keywords: Contempt of Court – Alleged wilful disobedience of earlier High Court and Court of Appeal judgments – Municipal Council house – Earlier judgment determining premises were rented accommodation rather than official quarters – Earlier quit notice quashed – Petitioner later seeking transfer of house to himself – Scope of earlier judicial orders – Earlier judgments did not direct respondents to transfer ownership of house – Requirement of deliberate/wilful disobedience – Conduct complained of considered against terms of prior orders.
legistation: Constitution – Article 105(3); contempt jurisdiction of the Court of Appeal.
